system.description:
This is a multi-rotor drone of the type that would be used by filmmakers, photographers, and high-end hobbyists. It is capable of recording video and sound, and may be equipped with night vision and additional sensors— or given a light, remotely operated weapon (no larger than a handgun) by a less ethical owner. Any collision with or attack on a light drone automatically destroys it, though it might be possible to salvage components such as its camera memory.

Resources TN 10.
